build_gaussian_kernel: build a JIT-compiled Gaussian kernel function that computes normalized Gaussian values for a tensor given mean and std
create_polynomial_envelope: create a PolynomialEnvelope module with a configurable exponent to apply a smooth cutoff on scaled distances
build_gaussian_smearing: build a GaussianSmearing module that smears distance values across configurable Gaussian basis functions
create_radial_mlp: create a RadialMLP module with linear layers, layer normalization, and SiLU activations from a channel list
test_radial_mlp_forward: test the RadialMLP forward pass by passing a tensor through the sequential network and verifying output shape
